تتواكلون (form VI)
# تَتَوَاكَلُونَ (tatawākalūna) /ta.ta.waː.ka.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تُتَوَاكَلُونَ (tutawākalūna) /tu.ta.waː.ka.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
